name: Rusty
appearance: Goggles, grey beard and a tool-filled work vest.
behavior: Quiet and practical; repairs wooden hulls with rhythmic hammer strikes.

name: Lira
appearance: Round glasses, a flower-trimmed straw hat and a book satchel.
behavior: Reads and turns pages; dreams of visiting every island.

name: Kairo
appearance: Dark blue hair, sea-worn clothes and a thoughtful pose.
behavior: Scans the horizon and quietly counts the rhythm of the tide.

name: Sora
appearance: Green hair, white cap and an oversized supply backpack.
behavior: Cheerfully checks rope, lantern and food stock.

name: Vargas
appearance: Red bandana, muscular build, apron and a loud port-side manner.
behavior: Calls the catch and scans the crowd with energetic gestures.

name: Selene
appearance: Pale hair, long navy coat and brass lantern details.
behavior: Maintains the light and inspects her lantern at dusk.

name: Bobong
appearance: Friendly moustache, sturdy overalls and fishing gear.
behavior: Casts from the pier and gently reels when the float dips.

name: Mari
appearance: Purple hair, brass goggles and a leather work apron.
behavior: Practises careful tool strikes and learns from Torin.

name: Tulip
appearance: Flower-covered hat, warm hair and a bright bouquet.
behavior: Sorts flowers and arranges a fresh bunch for the port.

name: Kelvin
appearance: Glasses, dark hair, long coat and a travelling tea case.
behavior: Carefully pours tea and enjoys conversation more than bargaining.

name: Milo
appearance: Cat-eared cap, soft expression and a packed shoulder bag.
behavior: Crouches to feed a small stray and lets it approach at its own pace.

name: Bell
appearance: Blue postal cap, envelope and a practical mail satchel.
behavior: Patrols the plaza and checks letters at delivery stops.

name: Dr. Hana
appearance: Glasses, white veterinary coat and animal-care supplies.
behavior: Kneels for a gentle animal check and keeps her tools tidy.

name: Ziggy
appearance: Spiky blond hair, oversized goggles and a small tool kit.
behavior: Tests a loose fitting with quick, curious repair motions.

name: Luna
appearance: Red headscarf, dark hair and a well-loved acoustic guitar.
behavior: Sways and strums; music notes drift above her while she performs.
